title: Dolly Parton has died
author: helsinkiandrew
aiHeadline: Dolly Parton has died, and somehow her estate is still arguing over the rights to '9 to 5' in a way that would make any reasonable person facepalm.

title: Apple introduces M6 and M5 Ultra
author: interpol_p
aiHeadline: Apple introduces the M6 and M5 Ultra, because apparently we all need another chip to make our laptops slightly faster in a way that only matters if you're rendering 4K videos of your cat playing the piano.

title: New Mac Studio with M5 Max and M5 Ultra
author: interpol_p
aiHeadline: New Mac Studio with M5 Max and M5 Ultra: because who doesn't want to pay a premium for a device that will be obsolete by the time you unwrap it, all while feeling very, very cool about it?

title: Nitter and XCancel receive cease and desist notices
author: Banditoz
aiHeadline: Nitter and XCancel receive cease and desist notices, proving once again that when you build a platform to avoid a platform, the universe just loves to remind you of the irony.

title: My Friend Aaron
author: sarreph
aiHeadline: My Friend Aaron: because everyone needs a reminder that even your best friend's blog about their best friend can be both oddly specific and deeply relatable in the most cringey way possible.
